## Description

Please provide a concise summary of the changes made in this pull request and the context behind them.

- Fixes #(issue)
- Feature / Shader / Optimization / Test enhancement

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality or new shader preset)
- [ ] Performance optimization (GLSL or React re-render improvement)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test coverage addition

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows project conventions and style guidelines.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes without errors or warnings.
- [ ] `npm run test` passes all unit tests.
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds cleanly.
- [ ] Relevant documentation or README section updated.
